messages.subject: Project Juniper - signing arrangements
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

With the LSA now agreed, we propose execution by way of exchange of PDF signature pages on Monday 18 May. I'll circulate the execution version and signature pages this afternoon. Please confirm signatories: for Sutherland, Gordon Sutherland (MD); for Wexbourne, Daniel Wexbourne (CEO).

Kind regards,
Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant to Sarah Whitfield

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
